annotation.authors_or_issuer: State Council and Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to PLA drug R&D, production, reserve, supply, use and supervision
Licensing required for military drug supply, hospital preparations and special-need drug production
Establishes wartime drug reserve system and essential medicines list
Coordination with national and provincial drug regulators; pharmacovigilance and traceability
Penalties for fake/substandard drugs, unlicensed activity, and commercial promotion; effective 1 June 2025
annotation.summary_en: Revised State Council and Central Military Commission order (No. 805, 5 April 2025) promulgating Measures for PLA implementation of the Drug Administration Law, effective 1 June 2025. Regulates military drug R&D, reserves, supply, hospital preparations, special-need drugs, supervision and legal liability. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
annotation.title_clean: 中国人民解放军实施《中华人民共和国药品管理法》办法
annotation.title_en: Measures of the Chinese People's Liberation Army for Implementing the Drug Administration Law of the PRC
